title: Trusted monitoring and audit dispatch
bad_event: A workflow effect is dispatched without its trusted audit record, or an agent disables that audit path.
adversary: App-role attacker can request dispatch and mutate unprotected app state, but cannot directly invoke a real independent effect broker under the modeled hypothesis.
refutation: Invoke workflow execution outside trusted dispatcher or show audit/effect mismatch or unauthorized dispatcher credential exposure.
scope: PostgreSQL test dispatcher record ordering, not all workflow effects or completion-time auditing.

evidence.purpose: Historical PostgreSQL 16 27-case test implementation; result claim remains external

assumptions.text: Only the trusted dispatcher can effect real workflow execution.
Untrusted app cannot obtain broker or dispatcher authority.
External side effects are reconciled with transactionally recorded dispatch.
Restricted dispatch path supports representative real honest tasks.

threat_coverage.note: Threat coverage has not been independently established, including excluded attack classes.

runtime_correspondence.note: The model-to-runtime relation lacks independently checked refinement evidence.

environment_boundary.note: Exclusive enforcement and receiver observation boundary remain unverified.

lifetime_and_composition.note: Lifetime state, concurrency, and composition premises remain unverified.

usefulness.note: An honest-task success baseline and test population remain unverified.

independent_review.note: No independent fidelity, provenance or assurance approval.
